recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: cool spring air over the bay, mostly clear but still jacket weather
sunset stretching past eight, long light brushing the west-facing hills
kitchen-table formats reshuffling cards for forty-draw games
forums humming with questions about where ideas begin and echoes end
melodic thump from headphones while the sidewalk stays quiet

composer-2-fast.concept: Ride two-lane bass pulses like a crosswalk stutter house track—catch only the gold hits in the correct lane before the gate narrows.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Lane-swap rhythm catch: left/right lanes spawn colored hit markers synced to a rising tempo.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Swipe left or right to commit lanes (one thumb, two zones).
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Clear one 45-second phrase without a miss to hear the ‘drop’ unlock visually.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Tempo ticks up, lanes jitter, phantom decoy markers appear to punish autopilot.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon waveform grid over Pacific fog colors (slate, cyan, muted gold).

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick a paper ferry across monochrome bay rings; wind vectors from the weather data bend each toss so the arc is never the same.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Physics flick with curved wind: aim through scoring hoops before the tide line rises.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Flick-release with optional micro-drag for spin.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Land three consecutive ring bullseyes to chain a comet trail bonus.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Wind gusts rotate, rings shrink, rogue gulls steal points if you aim idle too long.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Paper-cut fog layers and ink-wash water.

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Tri-sort falling mood shards labeled dream pop, house stutter, and rap cadence into chutes before the labels scramble mid-wave.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Three-way triage sorting: flick shards into left/center/right bins under color drift.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Swipe toward each bin edge (thumb swipe, three targets).
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Survive a full wave with no misfile to freeze time for two seconds of zen scoring.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Shards speed up, labels flip meaning, monochrome fakes mimic two genres at once.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Translucent prisms and soft gradients like album cover foil.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw a single-stroke circuit from phone icon to rocket before the shortcut grid erases—agents spun up in one breath.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: One-line path puzzle with nodes that expire; find the route that hits every sparkle.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Drag to draw; lift to confirm; tap to undo last segment.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Each solved circuit triggers a tiny launch shimmer plus haptic tick.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Dead nodes, one-way arrows, and moving endpoints force reroutes mid-draw.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Isometric glass tiles and soft bloom like a night-mode IDE theme.
